strongly.title: Strongly
strongly.description: Strongly is a Flutter workout tracking application designed to help users create personalized training programs, log every workout, and monitor their progress. Built with an offline-first architecture, it automatically synchronizes data, integrates RevenueCat subscriptions, and focuses on performance, reliability, and a seamless user experience.
strongly.imageAlt: Strongly fitness app featuring workout tracking, templates, and performance analytics

cookit.title: Cookit
cookit.description: A React-based recipe web application designed to provide a clean, responsive, and intuitive cooking experience. Users can browse recipes through a modern interface built with usability, performance, and frontend architecture in mind.
cookit.imageAlt: Cookit recipe application built with React featuring a modern responsive interface

muscleTrack.title: Muscle Track
muscleTrack.description: A Flutter mobile application for tracking workout progress. It allows users to record exercises, sets, and repetitions while monitoring their performance over time.
muscleTrack.imageAlt: Muscle Track mobile application with a modern workout tracking interface

seniorBretagne.title: Senior Bretagne
seniorBretagne.description: A modern and accessible website developed for Conseils & Gestion, a company providing home accessibility solutions for seniors, including stairlifts, walk-in showers, and emergency alert systems. Built with WordPress and custom themes, it focuses on responsive design, usability, and accessibility.
seniorBretagne.imageAlt: Senior Bretagne website featuring a modern responsive interface
